title: Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on What a Commission Is Worth
content:
# Cross-Desk Note with the Finance Desk on What a Commission Is Worth

What a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is worth is read either from the promotional financing plan that finances the till transaction the commission was written on, or from the commission's own quoted total and the repricings booked to it. Which of the two, and how much of it, turns on whether such a plan finances that till transaction and on whether it still stands open.

## The three readings

| Where | What the commission is worth is read as |
|---|---|
| The commission was written on a till transaction that a promotional financing plan held with the chain finances and that plan still stands open | The financed amount on that plan together with the amount paid at the till when the sale was written |
| The commission was written on such a till transaction and that plan no longer stands open | The financed amount on that plan alone |
| Otherwise | The quoted total recorded on the commission together with every repricing booked to it |

## Where the records are

The till transaction the commission was opened on stands on the commission record. Whether a plan finances that same till transaction, the financed amount at its opening, the amount the customer paid at the till on the day of sale and the state the plan stands in are held under Belrose Promotional Financing Plans, against that same till transaction. A plan still stands open while it stands active; a plan standing in any other state no longer stands open.

## Readings (hypothetical)

- A commission written on a till transaction that a plan finances, the plan standing active, the financed amount at opening USD 9000.00 and the amount paid at the till USD 1000.00: what the commission is worth is USD 10000.00.
- The same commission where the plan no longer stands active: what the commission is worth is USD 9000.00.
- A commission written on a till transaction no plan finances, quoted at USD 9500.00 with USD 250.00 of repricings booked to it: what the commission is worth is USD 9750.00.
